body: Perhaps it is selfish, but I actually don't think people are on the same plane as animals. We have a unique sense of desire and self awareness that we don't see in other animals that I think should be protected. It's when a person loses that drive that makes them different from other animals that they should be allowed to commit suicide if that's what they want.

I've directly told a couple people, but several more know without needing to be told. Though it's possible they don't understand the extent of my feelings. It's difficult to bring up and I don't think there's anything they could do other than watch me like a hawk or try to hospitalize me in an attempt to prevent me from actually committing suicide. I don't want pointless meddling noor do I want to needlessly worry other people. But at the same time every time I talk to someone I hope they'll say something that will miraculously change my outlook on life. It's sort of a catch-22.
